text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text:
Hey Homare.
Can you stop that?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ねぇホマレ。
それ、
やめてくれない？

text_block_list.name: Homare
text_block_list.text:
Stop what~?
I'm not doing anything~
text_block_list.orig_text:
それって何～？
私何もしてないよ～

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text:
You're following behind me,
sometimes opening your eyes wide, staring over here. You know it's true?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あたしの後ろをついてきながら、
時々目を開けてじっくりこっち見てるでしょ。
気づいてるのよ？

text_block_list.name: Homare
text_block_list.orig_text:
え～？
なんのことか分かんないな～

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text: There! That opening-your-eyes-wide thing, I’m asking you to stop that!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ほら今！
そのカッて目を開けるのをやめなさいって言ってるの！

text_block_list.name: Homare
text_block_list.orig_text:
人は……
瞬きをするものだよ……？

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text:
Such an impactful blink, isn't it?
You're curious about that guide fairy, aren't you?
Want to investigate?
text_block_list.orig_text:
そんなド迫力の瞬きがあってたまるもんですか。
どうせアレよね、
ガイド妖精が気になってるんでしょ？
調べたいな～
とか思ってるんでしょ？

text_block_list.name: Homare
text_block_list.text:
I can't hide anything from Ameth-chan~
See, Ameth-chan is a special existence different from Nebbia-chan, right?
It's rare, so my blinking increased out of curiosity...
text_block_list.orig_text:
アメスちゃんに隠し事はできないね～
ほら、
アメスちゃんってネビアちゃんとも違う
特殊な存在でしょ？
珍しいからつい、
瞬きの回数が増えちゃって……

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text: So you're going to push through with the blinking excuse...
text_block_list.orig_text: 瞬きで押し通す気なのね……

text_block_list.name: Homare
text_block_list.text:
More importantly, Ameth-chan, why don't we take a break?
We've been running non-stop, and you're tired, right?
I'll put on your sunscreen~?
text_block_list.orig_text:
それよりアメスちゃん、
そろそろ休憩しない？
走り通しで疲れたよね？
私が日焼け止め塗ってあげるよ～？

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text:
In this flow, "Okay, please," is not something that happens, right?
What's with you? Are you perhaps excited about summer?
text_block_list.orig_text:
この流れで
じゃあお願い、
ってなるわけないわよね？
なんなの？　
もしかして夏で浮かれてるの？

text_block_list.name: Homare
text_block_list.text: I'll generously apply the sunscreen on your wings too~?
text_block_list.orig_text:
その羽にも
たっぷり塗ってあげるよ～？

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.orig_text: だからその目をやめなさい！
